title: Imp Jar & Wick Liquor Mantra 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Mantra is the brainchild of Imp Jar and Wick Liquor and is a flavour that offers a symphony of summer in a bottle. This e-liquid captures the sharp, sweet essence of mixed berries swirled into smooth, icy sorbet, each draw delivering the sweet and tangy notes of a homemade chilled berry dessert. The richness of the berries offers a delectable, refreshing taste, akin to enjoying your favourite sorbet on a warm, sunny day. With each puff, you're enveloped in the vibrant sweetness of the berries, making Mantra a must-try for anyone seeking a delightfully cool burst of berry. This delicious e-liquid is just one of several in an exciting collaboration between Imp Jar and e-liquid legends, Wick Liquor, creators of some of the most unique flavours in vaping. This thrilling partnership means that you can enjoy some of Wick Liquors most iconic creations, with Imp Jar’s 50/50 formulation for use in a wide variety of pod kits and starter kits. Shortfill bottles from Imp Jar E-liquids offer a more versatile ratio of 50PG/50PG than traditional shortfills, which means you can use the e-liquid with a more diverse range of vape kits and coils of different resistances. With Imp Jar shortfills, you’re no longer limited to sub-ohm vaping kits, and can enjoy the superb value of shortfills in a huge variety of MTL vape kits. Each bottle comes with 50ml of nicotine-free e-liquid and an additional 10ml of space for one 10ml nicotine shot, giving you complete control over your vaping experience. To create 60ml of 3mg e-liquid, simply add 1 x 10ml 18mg nicotine shot to a 50ml shortfill, give it a good shake, and voila, you have your perfect mix. Shortfills offer even more longevity from your favourite e-liquid flavours and are a more economical and convenient option over 10ml bottles of pre-mixed e-liquid. Imp Jar’s original collection of e-liquids replicate a wide array of delicious flavours made popular across numerous disposable vape devices, ranging from fruity delights to frosty menthols, sugary candies, to refreshing beverages.
